text:
maya.k: [incident-bot] realtime-p99 spike detected for service=runtime-gen region=us-west-2 :rotating_light:
oncall-bot: Paging @chris.s and @eli — severity P1 latency SLO breach (p99 > 2.5s) across streaming and non-streaming routes
chris.s: seeing it, joining. quick heads-up — p99s shot up ~10:08 UTC. dashboards show streaming tail stalls increasing
eli: I'm oncall console. starting quick checks: infra scaling, GPU queue depth, recent deploys
maya.k: logs: 
```
[10:08:31] worker=gw-12 request_id=abc123 latency=4.8s route=/chat/stream status=200
[10:08:32] worker=gw-09 request_id=def456 stalled kv_fetch timeout
```
chris.s: any deploys in last 30m? maya.k: no deploys. small config change to cache invalidation earlier today at 08:40 but unrelated? maybe
eli: checking autoscaler: pool-dedicated-usw2 at 85% utilization  — but queue depth spiking on fastpath slots
platform-runner: ps://infra/metrics/grafana/d/latency?var-service=runtime-gen (link)
maya.k: quick mitigation options: 1) revert cache invalidation 2) bump dedicated pool min replicas 3) enable degraded fastpath (short-circuit quantized model)
chris.s: prioritize bumping pool and enable degraded fastpath. can someone flip the fastpath toggle? eli: I can enable degraded-fastpath now, giving 10-15% lower quality but faster latency
eli: toggled degraded-fastpath ON at 10:12 UTC :white_check_mark:
chris.s: scaling: `kubectl scale --replicas=12 deploy/pool-dedicated-usw2` (I queued an autoscale override for +4)
maya.k: monitor p99. if not improving, enable region-fallback to us-east-1 for critical traffic
platform-runner: quick log grep shows increased "kv-cache miss" rates since 10:05 — maybe cache eviction thrash
eli: running a kcache inspect: `curl -s http://kvcache-admin/inspect | jq '.miss_rate, .evictions_last_min'`
chris.s: also check tokenization hotpath — long inputs causing more KV chatter? any change in request length distribution
maya.k: sampling request shapes: most are 256-512 tokens, no sudden spike in length
oncall-bot: alert annotation: added runbook link https://runbooks.internal/realtime-p99
eli: p99 decreased from 4.8s -> 2.1s after degraded-fastpath + scale at 10:18 UTC
chris.s: good, but still above SLO. enabling region-fallback for 20% of traffic as canary
maya.k: routed 20% critical routes to us-east-1 at 10:20 UTC
platform-runner: us-east-1 p99=1.2s, overall p99 now 1.6s at 10:22 UTC
eli: continue to monitor: check streaming stalls metric (stream.stall_count) and kv-cache evictions
chris.s: action items: - create postmortem ticket - investigate cache eviction pattern - review fastpath perf regression
maya.k: will own the postmortem. tagging @platform-runner and @eli for data
oncall-bot: severity downgraded to P2 at 10:35 UTC — SLO mitigated via fallback and degraded fastpath
eli: leaving handoff to next oncall in 2h. adding notes to incident channel
maya.k: thanks all. final comment: keep degraded-fastpath until kcache bug root cause fixed. :thumbsup:
